topic: letters A, B, C with words that start with them
title: ABC Fun with Pip, Lulu, and Bo
yt_description:
Sing along with Pip, Lulu, and Bo as they learn letters A, B, and C! This cheerful song helps toddlers recognize these letters and some simple words that start with them.

🎵 ABC Fun with Pip, Lulu, and Bo

Hello friends, it's time to play!
Let's learn letters A, B, C today!

A is for apple, shiny and red,
B is for ball that bounces ahead,
C is for cat that purrs on your bed.

A, B, C, sing with me,
Letters are fun, as you can see!
A, B, C, come and play,
Learning letters every day!

A is for ant, tiny and small,
B is for bird that sings in the fall,
C is for car, big and tall.

A, B, C, sing with me,
Letters are fun, as you can see!
A, B, C, wave goodbye,
See you soon, friends, by and by!

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
